definitions.gloss: to unfold; to develop; to carry out
definitions.explanation: To develop or execute an event, battle, argument, or performance over a period of time, often with dramatic or dynamic qualities.

examples.japanese: ⟦{両|りょう}→両：11182_ryou⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{熱戦|ねっせん}→熱戦：21496_nessen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げた。
examples.english: Both teams engaged in a fierce battle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{議会|ぎかい}→議会：02661_gikai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げられた。
examples.english: A heated debate unfolded in the parliament.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}スペクタクル→大スペクタクル：noentry⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{舞台|ぶたい}→舞台：03606_butai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げられる。
examples.english: A grand spectacle will unfold on stage.

notes:
・{繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げる → {繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げない (negative)
・{繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げる → {繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げて (te-form)
・{繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げる → {繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げた (past)

FORMATION:
Compound verb: ⟦{繰|く}る→繰る：noentry⟧ (to reel, to turn) + ⟦{広|ひろ}げる→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧ (to spread)

The image is of unrolling a scroll or spreading something out.

COLLOCATIONS:
・⟦{激戦|げきせん}→激戦：13415_gekisen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げる - to wage a fierce battle
・⟦{攻防|こうぼう}→攻防：12925_koubou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げる - to exchange attacks and defenses
・⟦{論争|ろんそう}→論争：03786_ronsou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げる - to carry on a controversy
・⟦ドラマ→ドラマ：03867_dorama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げる - to unfold a drama

REGISTER:
Often used in news reporting and formal writing to describe ongoing events with dramatic qualities.
